targets.authors: Björkman Nyqvist, M., S. Jayachandran, and C. Zipfel
targets.title: A mother’s voice: Impacts of spousal communication training on child health investments.
targets.evidence_quote: In the present report prepared for the Institute for Replication (Brodeur et al., 2026), we investigate whether the authors’ analytical results are computationally reproducible and robust.
targets.outcome_computational_quote: We successfully computationally reproduced all of the study’s main results (Tables 1 through 5) from the data included in the replication package (V1).
targets.outcome_robustness_quote: Only the removal of trimming in Table 4 leads to one of the main results becoming marginally insignificant. Other previously significant effects are more likely to lose significance due to these changes, though these are not central to the original paper’s main conclusions.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Original main numbers recovered from V1 despite setup corrections and V2 missing a variable. Most robustness checks preserve conclusions, but the authors identify removal of trimming as weakening one main result; at least one central finding is therefore challenged. This qualifies the broadly positive abstract.
